head: 7c23171cf631b5a775f8082240bf263a1528dad7
authorization: 12.11: готовые карты, без подбора порогов; сначала 26 связей и пять рабочих случаев; при провале остановиться; полный трекер запрещён.
stages: Both named screens are one bounded admission package, frozen together before scores. No next scientific stage in this task.
formula: 2 population covariance / (population variance_a + population variance_b + squared mean difference); moments divide by m.
ablation: variance_only removes only squared paired mean difference; diagnostic, never post-hoc replacement of primary.
fixed: Saved old per-arm winning shift and full template, seven old geometry inputs, 34 visual inputs, 42 fitted parameters including intercept.

fit.geometry: saved G7 fold normalizations; saved final normalization for 6 final fits
fit.signal: training-only channel means and common RMS standard deviation over nonconstant channels; constant scale=1

refusal: Fewer than three cells, fully constant reference/current or missing input: stop admission without imputation; no visual evidence. No runtime integration.

acceptance.cv: C34 agreement own>=17, foreign<=1 with at least one strict improvement over ready common-scale baseline.
acceptance.screen: Preserve correct own70 and own1102; accept at least one of own232/own832 AND reject foreign574. All at threshold0.
acceptance.joint: Both primary gates and independent audit must pass. Otherwise stop this fixed version; no tuning, no tracker.
acceptance.component: No unique FlyVis advantage without positive paired-video interval versus both matched ordinary agreement controls.

uncertainty.method: paired percentile95; omit and count samples lacking a class
uncertainty.scope: descriptive development resampling, not independent generalization

limitations: 26 reused development links, only6 foreign; five preselected diagnostic cases. Not HOTA, not actual assignment/public-ID survival.
